accepted_fullB_direction.interpretation: The accepted-run z encoding is authoritative. Numeric equality with the AD alpha025/0.25 direction is required; its historical signed-zero differences are retained below, not treated as input-direction error.

control_zero_history.scope: Accepted-run/public proposal and actual parent-delta AD direction are the same real vector with separate zero encodings. All ten native finite inputs are byte-identical; AD recording identities use the parent-delta bytes, not a relabeled accepted-control encoding.

interpretation_limits: This is an offline replay of already saved endpoint arithmetic; it executes no model.
Native number coordinates and their units remain conditional; no physical number-unit or whole-budget certification is made.
A passing native/BT subset with a failing profile coordinate still means the joint 33-category experiment fails.
Saved RTTOV endpoint BTs are direct-value observations; no endpoint K is differentiated or rerun here.
